contract.name: Definition
contract.q: Why does it exist, what does it produce, when does it start and finish?
fields: The change in the world when it completes.
The job its performers are trying to get done.
What must be true before work begins.
What must be true for it to be complete.

contract.name: Flow
contract.q: How does work move, and what must happen before what?
fields: Work that can safely run concurrently.
Inputs, teams and systems it waits on.
States and the triggers between them.

contract.name: Cases
contract.q: What situations can occur beyond the hoped-for one?
fields: Valid different routes to the outcome.
Boundary conditions that must still work.

contract.name: Routing
contract.q: Where does work go next — including back, up, or nowhere?
fields: Hand off when exit is met.

contract.name: Controls
contract.q: What determines readiness, and what must never be violated?
fields: Decision points that allow or block.

contract.name: Knowledge
contract.q: Which established knowledge applies, and of what kind?

contract.name: Lenses
contract.q: Whose perspectives matter, and what do they demand?
fields: What each lens needs to see.
What each lens has a say in.

contract.name: Execution
contract.q: Who performs the work, and who has authority?
fields: Who may approve, override, escalate, stop.

contract.name: Artifacts
contract.q: What goes in, what comes out, what proves it?
fields: Proof that controls ran and decisions are justified.

contract.name: Continuity
contract.q: What is handed on, how is it traced, how long may it take, how is it measured, and what do we learn?
fields: What is handed to whom when the unit completes.
The trace IDs this unit creates or carries forward.
How the unit's performance is measured.
What is captured to improve next time, and where.
